Hildegard 0.1.8 is a pre-alpha. It is the first release signed with Hildegard's update key, so from here on every
install updates itself.

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Desktop app:** pick your system's download below, or from [dbaney.com/hildegard](https://dbaney.com/hildegard/).

Installed already? This one time, run `hildegard update` or reinstall: earlier releases weren't signed, so they can't
find an update by themselves. From 0.1.8 on, Hildegard updates itself.

## New

- **Signed updates.** This release publishes `latest.json` and a signature for every file an update runs. The server
  updates itself once nothing is rendering (or tells you, if you choose **Ask me first** in Settings), the desktop app
  offers **Restart to update** in its tray menu, and the Omarchy panel shows **Update to**. Each one checks the
  signature before it installs anything.

## Fixed

- Before a release offered updates, the update check said GitHub couldn't be reached. It now says the newest release
  doesn't offer updates yet, and Settings says how often Hildegard checks before its first check.
